groups.defect: In EmbeddableHostsController, update and destroy use EmbeddableHost.where(id:).first without a nil check, so a missing record raises NoMethodError and returns a 500 instead of a 404. save_host also assumes params[:embeddable_host] is present.

answer.reasoning: Both suggestions cover the same lines (9-17) and report the same two problems. First, update and destroy use the result of where(id:).first without checking for nil, so a missing record ends in a 500 instead of a 404. Second, save_host reads params[:embeddable_host] without checking that it exists. They are clearly duplicates of the same kind (same_location). needsUnifiedComment is false because each suggestion on its own already covers both problems, so either one can stand for the group without losing anything.
